title: Authentic Chicken Tacos with Cilantro Lime Slaw
description: Flavorful Mexican-style chicken tacos with perfectly seasoned meat, fresh slaw, and traditional toppings.
instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, salt, and pepper. Rub this spice mixture all over the chicken breasts.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned chicken and cook for 6-7 minutes per side until fully cooked (internal temperature 165°F/74°C). Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes, then dice into small pieces.
3. While chicken cooks, prepare the cilantro lime slaw: In a large bowl, combine shredded cabbage, chopped cilantro, lime juice, a drizzle of olive oil, and a pinch of salt. Toss well and refrigerate.
4. Warm the corn tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a gas flame for 30 seconds per side until slightly charred and pliable.
5. Assemble tacos: Place diced chicken on each tortilla, top with cilantro lime slaw, diced tomatoes, avocado slices, crumbled queso fresco, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice.
6. Serve immediately with hot sauce on the side if desired.
